page.overview:
What is Kyara Kyara no Mi?

The Kyara Kyara no Mi is a non-canon Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that provides consciousness to non-living souls, as well as allowing the soul to merge with others. It was eaten by Lip Shark.

The Kyara Kyara no Mi resembles purple poop, drawn in a manga-esque style. Like all Devil Fruits, it has a pattern of swirls on it, however, it lacks any stem.

The main strength of this Devil Fruit is the ability to merge with other people, providing massive increases in strength and speed. It is unclear if there are restrictions on who the user can merge with.

After the timeskip, Lip Shark could merge with the bow of the Maying Gorry.
